description: This file defines the RoleSheetPopulator class, which populates an Excel workbook sheet with role data for bulk import purposes. It creates a sheet, sets up layout, and fills in role IDs and names extracted from provided RoleData objects.

classes.name: RoleSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating a sheet in an Excel workbook with role data, including setting layout and formatting.

methods.name: RoleSheetPopulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of roles to populate.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and populates the roles sheet within a given workbook, applying a date format.

methods.name: populateRoles
methods.description: Fills the sheet with role data, starting at a specified row index.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the column widths and header row for the roles sheet.
